messages:
maria: Quick brief 2-launch bundle2 needed: hero + 2 headline options per page, 3 short CTAs per mode, a tweet-sized benchmark blurb, social posts cadence, webinar landing copy, and distinct demo URLs for inbound routing. Deadline: Wed EOD. Base brief: https://tiny.redwood/launch-kit
scott: I'll draft hero variants and the one-line benchmark. Tone: concise, engineering-friendly. Plan to call out one metric per mode (latency or SLA or cost).
tom: I'll own social cadence and webinar landing. Thinking workshop format + hands-on examples. Proposed webinar date = two weeks from now please confirm.
elaine: Security reminder: Private copy must include KMS/HSM + on-prem availability. Dedicated needs "reserved GPU pools" and SLA wording. I'll review Private copy Wed AM.
nora: Routing: we'll create 3 demo endpoints so leads auto-tag: `/demo/hosted?utm_campaign=tri-launch`, `/demo/dedicated?utm_campaign=tri-launch`, `/demo/private?utm_campaign=tri-launch`. Form fields: deployment preference, monthly token volume, contact urgency. Sales queues: fast-trial (hosted) vs enterprise (dedicated+private).
jess: CTA A/B ideas (short): Hosted: ["Start hosted trial", "Try hosted now", "Launch a hosted trial"]; Dedicated: ["Reserve dedicated capacity", "Book capacity demo", "Get SLA-backed throughput"]; Private: ["Request private deployment", "Schedule on-prem demo", "Talk to enterprise sales"].
scott: Benchmark blurb candidates (tweet-sized): A) "95th-pct latency <115ms  up to 3x token cost savings vs baseline (internal tests)" B) "<115ms (95th)  3x token savings in our tests"  engineering to confirm exact numbers.
tom: Social cadence idea: Mon: teaser (hosted angle) w/ short hero; Wed: benchmark thread (dedicated perf); Thu: webinar invite (private deployments); Fri: roundup + blog. Copy sample: "New: Redwood Inference Run LLMs with predictable latency and lower cost. Webinar 5/xx. Register -> https://redwood.ai/w/tri-launch?utm_source=twitter"
marketing-bot: calendar: Webinar placeholder created for 2026-05-05 10:00 PT. Reminders set 7d and 1d prior.
maria: Good. We also need 2 headline alternatives per mode. Keep them short (6-9 words). And three CTAs each as jess listed. Engineering and security sign-off timelines: engineering confirms benchmark Tue EOD; security reviews Private copy Wed 12:00 PT.
scott: Quick hero drafts: Hosted: 1) "Hosted API for fast, low-friction inference" 2) "Get started with hosted inference in minutes"; Dedicated: 1) "Reserved GPU pools. Predictable throughput." 2) "Dedicated capacity with SLA-backed performance"; Private: 1) "Private deployments: VPC or on-prem" 2) "Bring Redwood behind your firewall"
jess: I prefer Hosted hero #2, Dedicated #2, Private #1 for clarity on the homepage.
nora: I'll provision the three demo paths and wire UTMs to the CRM. Also will expose a hidden form field to route to fast-trial vs enterprise queue.
tom: Webinar subject lines (A/B): A) "Cut inference cost without sacrificing latency" B) "How teams run predictable LLM inference at scale". Landing hero: "Live workshop: production inference patterns for cost, latency, and reliability."
elaine: Noted. Security will check Private phrasing Wed morning; if HSM/KMS details need to be toned down on public pages we can push them into the product details section.
maria: Assignments: scott = heroes + benchmark blurb; tom = webinar page + social posts; jess = CTA tuning + microcopy; nora = demo URLs + routing; elaine = security review. Deliver drafts by Wed EOD so we can freeze copy Thu morning. Sync Fri 9am PT to finalize schedule. Thanks all :rocket:
